problems.description: Requirements REF-13 and REF-14 contradict each other regarding whether admins can export the audit log.
problems.quote: Admins must be able to export the audit log.

problems.description: Requirement REF-09 does not specify the minimum password length.
problems.quote: The password must have a minimum length.

problems.description: Requirement REF-01 does not cover the scenario where the email address is not registered.
problems.quote: The system must send a password reset link to the registered email address within 60 seconds.

problems.description: Test case TC-017 checks for a minimum password length of 8 characters, but requirement REF-12 specifies 12 characters.
problems.quote: The new password must be at least 12 characters long.

problems.description: Test case TC-024 checks for a scenario where admins cannot export the audit log, but requirement REF-13 states they can.
problems.quote: Admins must be able to export the audit log.

questions.question: What is the minimum password length specified in REF-09?
Which requirement should be kept: REF-13 or REF-14?

recommendations.text: Clarify the minimum password length in requirement REF-09.
Resolve the contradiction between requirements REF-13 and REF-14.
Update test cases TC-017 and TC-024 to align with the correct requirements.
